topic: GitHub Enterprise and other gh hosts are not in allowedDomains
detail: orch adds only api.github.com and github.com to sandbox.network.allowedDomains. A space whose gh profile logs in to a GitHub Enterprise host, or gh commands that reach other hosts (release downloads from objects.githubusercontent.com, codeload.github.com), still need an approval a headless session cannot give. orch never reads hosts.yml to learn the host.
